resources.string: Suggestions from your own history through an AI model you connect. Off unless you turn it on.
Use the https address your provider documents, or http for a model on this phone or your local network.
Enter the key for this address.
Connect to pick from the list, or type the model name.
Not set. Needed for the food guide.

Weight, body fat, skeletal muscle and visceral fat level from your scale or InBody. Kept on this phone and in its Android backup, in Drive if you keep coach data there, and recent ones go to the coach when it is on.
From a screenshot, Health Connect or typed in
Health Connect did not give access. Once it stops asking, open Health Connect, tap FitGymLog and allow Weight and Body fat.
No measurements found. Pick a screenshot or photo that shows the numbers.
That picture could not be opened.
The picture goes to the AI provider you connected, read by your chat model, which must read images. Crop out your name if you like. You check the numbers before they are saved.
To read screenshots, turn on and connect the coach in Settings.
Also use the weight and body fat your scale app saves in Health Connect, for the chart, your calorie target and the coach.
Weight and body fat from Health Connect are used for the chart, your calorie target and the coach.
Enter at least one value in a believable range.
Daily calorie target: about %1$,d kcal (maintenance about %2$,d kcal), worked out from your body and the workouts logged in the last 4 weeks.
Daily calorie target: about %1$,d kcal (maintenance about %2$,d kcal), worked out from the lean mass in your latest body fat reading and the workouts logged in the last 4 weeks.
Add bodyweight, sex, birth date and either height or a body fat reading for a daily calorie target. Adults only.
Protein and calories for the day and meal ideas after each workout. Nothing to log.

Your workouts and sets, today\'s workout with how long you have trained and rested, bodyweight, sex, goal, recent body measurements including those from Health Connect, and the calorie target the app works out, your messages to the coach with the names of the exercises in the app, your routines when you ask about a week in the check-in, and, if you share them, your saved notes. A screenshot you ask it to read goes too. Height and birth date are only used on the phone. All of it goes only to the provider you connect.
Injuries, food limits, schedule and goals you saved.
Keep coach data in Google Drive

Saved notes, coach notes on workouts and body measurements go into the hidden app folder of your Drive with your workouts, so they come back after a reinstall. The chat is not synced. Turning this off leaves the Drive copy until you delete the app\'s hidden data in Drive.
Turn on Google Drive sync in Settings for this to take effect.
The messages sent for today\'s targets, without your key.
Nothing is sent yet. Start a workout with exercises you have logged before.
Suggestions are never applied without you. The key is encrypted on this phone and sent only to the address above. General guidance, not medical or dietary advice.
Set up the coach in Settings first.
From your last three sessions. Nothing changes until you apply.
The coach is looking at your last sessions…
No answer from the coach this time, so these come from the progression rules. %1$s
All reps last time, but close to failure
Third stall in a row, eased off
The coach is reading this workout…
General guidance from your coach model, not medical or dietary advice. You can turn the food guide off in Coach settings.
Ask about today\'s workout or to change it, a sore knee, what to eat, or anything about your training.
Clear the chat? Saved notes stay.
These no longer fit this workout.
Only for the workout it was suggested in.
The coach asks before saving anything, and you can edit or delete any of it. Notes are kept on this phone, and in Google Drive if you turn that on in Coach settings.
The key was refused. Check it in Coach settings.
The address or the model was not found. Check them in Coach settings.
